name: cx-product-analytics
description: Analyze how users move through a web or mobile app with Coralogix Product Analytics and the `cx product-analytics` CLI — RUM applications, most visited pages, clicks, rage and dead clicks, custom actions, funnels, conversion and drop-off, which users converted or dropped, page paths, heatmaps and scroll depth. Use when the user asks "where do users drop off", "funnel conversion", "conversion rate of checkout", "which users dropped out of the funnel", "what pages do users visit after /cart", "user journey", "user paths", "most clicked buttons", "rage clicks", "dead clicks", "heatmap", "scroll depth", "top pages", "custom events", "create a funnel", "save a pathway", "is product analytics enabled", or wants product analytics on RUM data.

findings.excerpt: cx product-analytics views list --app web-shop --start now-7d
cx product-analytics pathways query --app web-shop --view /cart --direction forward --start now-7d
